lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs arranged in multiple horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, with a high-density cluster of larger circular nodes located posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the upper surface and shadow-induced low luminance on the lower surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct light-colored remora is visible swimming directly below the ventral surface of the primary pectoral fin.
